class.name: YAMLSecurity
class.brief_description: Controls security policies for resource loading during YAML parsing.
class.description: YAMLSecurity manages restrictions on which resources can be loaded from YAML files using the [code]!Resource[/code] tag. It helps guard against unsafe loading of untrusted content by allowing control over allowed resource paths and types. Loading resources are limited to [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] root paths for security reasons. Paths can include wildcard patterns, such as [code]*[/code] for single-segment and [code]**[/code] for recursive matching. Resources can also be filtered by type, such as blocking [code]Script[/code] or [code]GDExtension[/code] by default. Calling [method clear_type_restrictions] will remove the default blocks. [b]Note:[/b] No path-based restrictions will be enforced until [method allow_path] is called. [b]Example:[/b] [codeblocks] [gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security() security.allow_path("user://mods/*/textures", ["Texture2D"]) security.allow_path("res://**", "MeshInstance3D") security.block_type("PackedScene") # Override the default YAMLSecurity instance with a custom one when parsing var result = YAML.load_file("res://config.yaml", security) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] In this example: - [Texture2D] resource types are allowed to load from any direct subfolder of [code]user://mods/[/code] followed by [code]/textures[/code] path, such as [code]user://mods/my_mod/textures/player.png[/code][br]- [MeshInstance3D] resource types are allowed to load from any directory under [code]res://[/code], such as [code]res://assets/models/player.tres[/code][br]- [PackedScene] resource types are blocked globally

method.name: allow_path
method.description: Allows loading resources from paths matching [param path_prefix]. Wildcards are supported: - [code]*[/code] matches a single path segment[br]- [code]**[/code] matches any number of nested segments Optionally restricts allowed types to those listed in [param type_names]. If omitted, all non-blocked types are allowed.

method.name: block_type
method.description: Blocks a resource type globally. Any resources of this type will be rejected during YAML parsing.

method.name: clear_path_restrictions
method.description: Removes all allowed path rules. No path-based restrictions will be enforced until [method allow_path] is used again.

method.name: clear_type_restrictions
method.description: Removes all blocked resource types. [b]Note:[/b] [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] are blocked by default for security reasons; calling this will remove those protections.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets all rules to default values. Clears any custom path or type rules, and blocks the [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] types again.
